name: Import has no side effects
setup: Import in an empty temporary working directory with network calls blocked.
expected: No new files, worker processes, network calls or dataset access.

name: Editable installation
setup: Install the declared package in a clean virtual environment.
expected: Import and the version entry point work using declared dependencies.

name: Preserve unrelated work
setup: Begin with an unrelated uncommitted file.
expected: Bootstrap does not overwrite, remove or stage that file automatically.

name: Truthful metadata
setup: Inspect README/metadata before any public publication.
expected: No false PyPI link, DOI, supported-platform claim or passing-CI badge.

name: Instruction loading
setup: Start a Codex task at the intended root.
expected: It identifies AGENTS, current stage and relevant specifications actually read.

name: Unknown config key
setup: Add evaluation.secret_magic=true.
expected: ConfigurationError names the unsupported key.

name: Duplicate JSON keys
setup: Provide a JSON object with the same key twice.
expected: Loader rejects it before last-value-wins parsing.

name: Boolean integer ambiguity
setup: Set split.n_splits=true.
expected: Validation fails rather than interpreting true as 1.

name: Optional defaults
setup: Omit positive_class and max_input_mb from otherwise valid config.
expected: Defaults are null and 128 respectively; no hidden role inference.

name: Unknown schema version
setup: Set schema_version to an unsupported major value.
expected: Clear incompatible-version error; no best-effort reinterpretation.

name: JSON null semantics
setup: Serialize an undefined AUC with a reason.
expected: value=null and a non-empty reason; never NaN.

name: No Infinity output
setup: Attempt to serialize a non-finite numeric result.
expected: Reject or explicitly map to a reasoned null at the metric boundary.

name: Offline schema validation
setup: Block all sockets while validating each local schema.
expected: No HTTP/schema download; supported examples validate.

name: Record round trip
setup: Serialize and read a non-sensitive fixture record.
expected: All schema-defined meanings, enums and ordering are preserved.

name: Config immutability
setup: Pass a config into each public helper and compare afterward.
expected: No silent mutation of user settings.

name: Private/public separation
setup: Serialize the same evaluation through both serializers.
expected: Public projection omits private IDs/digests; operational format is visibly sensitive.

name: Leading zeros
setup: Read IDs 001 and 1 from TSV.
expected: Two distinct participants/observation keys are preserved.

name: Duplicate headers
setup: Read a CSV with subject_id header twice.
expected: InputValidationError before dataframe auto-renaming.

name: UTF-8 BOM
setup: Read a BOM-prefixed header and Unicode IDs.
expected: Correct header recognition and exact legitimate IDs.

name: Whitespace identity
setup: Read a subject ID with a trailing space.
expected: Reject with sanitized repair message; do not trim silently.

name: Missing critical ID
setup: Read an empty participant or observation key.
expected: Fatal validation error; no assigned synthetic identity.

name: NA vocabulary
setup: Read literal NA as an ID and n/a as an optional missing value.
expected: NA stays a string; n/a is recognized missing.

name: Duplicate observation ID
setup: Two rows use the same observation key.
expected: Input rejected; no drop_duplicates fallback.

name: Shuffled feature rows
setup: Reverse feature table order relative to cohort.
expected: Features align exactly by observation ID.

name: Missing feature key
setup: Remove one cohort key from feature table.
expected: Join fails with missing count, not silent row intersection.

name: Extra feature key
setup: Add an observation not in cohort.
expected: Join fails explicitly.

name: Prohibited predictors
setup: Select diagnosis or subject_id as a feature.
expected: Configuration/input validation refuses it.

name: Numeric coercion
setup: Selected feature contains text or infinity.
expected: Input fails; recognized missing numeric cells remain missing.

name: DataFrame identity type
setup: Pass integer participant IDs through Python API.
expected: Refuse lossy implicit conversion and explain string requirement.

name: No input mutation
setup: Pass DataFrames and compare values/index/dtypes after loading.
expected: Original metadata/features remain unchanged.

name: Unsupported sources
setup: Pass a URL, XLSX, pickle or joblib path.
expected: Reject unsupported local format without network/deserialization.

name: Allocation guard
setup: Describe rows/features exceeding configured limits.
expected: Refuse before constructing avoidable dense arrays.

name: Digest invariance
setup: Reorder rows, then separately edit a mapped metadata value.
expected: Reorder retains digest; mapped change changes digest.

name: Paths with spaces
setup: Load files under a Unicode directory with spaces on supported systems.
expected: No shell quoting or hard-coded slash assumption.

name: People versus observations
setup: Use 18 people with two observations each.
expected: Inventory gives 18 people and 36 observations.

name: Repeated participants are not leakage
setup: Audit that cohort without any supplied splits.
expected: Informational repeat notice; no observed split violation.

name: Global session labels
setup: Every participant uses ses-01 and ses-02.
expected: Distinct people are not linked by session text.

name: Changing diagnosis
setup: One participant has different target labels over visits.
expected: Describe target variation; block constant-target baseline eligibility without relabeling.

name: Transitive dependency
setup: A links to B through family; B links to C through duplicate cluster.
expected: A/B/C form one protected component.

name: Dependency namespaces
setup: Family code X for one group and duplicate code X for unrelated people.
expected: No cross-field equality link unless an actual participant bridges them.

name: Missing protected field
setup: A declared family column contains missing values.
expected: Strict planning/evaluation blocked; missing values not grouped together.

name: Cross-site participant
setup: One participant has two site values.
expected: One identity retained; descriptive crossing notice.

name: Exact feature equality
setup: Different IDs share the same numeric feature vector.
expected: Heuristic review finding; no identity merge/drop.

name: All-missing vectors
setup: Several rows have all selected features missing.
expected: Skip duplicate-equality inference for those vectors and record reason.

name: Component ordering
setup: Permute rows of a transitive dependency fixture.
expected: Same memberships and deterministic component identifiers.

name: Hash collision confirmation
setup: Mock equal hashes for unequal feature vectors.
expected: Exact comparison prevents a false equality finding.

name: Known participant overlap
setup: Use bundled leaky plan with different visits on each side.
expected: Participant overlap detected even with no observation overlap.

name: Clean repeated cohort
setup: Use bundled clean plan.
expected: No subject/component overlap violations.

name: Observation overlap
setup: Insert the same observation into train and test.
expected: Always rejected including diagnostic mode.

name: Across-fold train reuse
setup: Use ordinary valid 3-fold CV.
expected: Repeated training membership across folds is not leakage.

name: Allowed same sites
setup: Subject-disjoint plan shares sites under unseen_participant.
expected: No site-separation violation.

name: Forbidden same sites
setup: Same plan declares unseen_site.
expected: Domain overlap error for the requested objective.

name: Unknown member
setup: Plan refers to obs-does-not-exist.
expected: Reject membership/identity mismatch; no positional lookup.

name: Missing partition row
setup: Omit a cohort observation from both train and test in one fold.
expected: Per-fold coverage violation.

name: Duplicate membership
setup: Duplicate one role/observation membership.
expected: Reject rather than collapse to a set silently.

name: Missing training class
setup: Outer train has only CN while target space includes AD.
expected: Evaluation blocked for that fold.

name: Missing test class
setup: Outer test has only CN but train has all classes.
expected: Class-coverage warning; not an invented full-class score.

name: Inner containment
setup: Put an outer-test ID into an inner training subset.
expected: Nested containment violation.

name: Inner protected overlap
setup: Separate related participants across inner train/validation.
expected: Protected-component violation.

name: Holdout audit
setup: A single valid train/test fold covers the cohort.
expected: Audit supported; complete_cv=false and evaluator not permitted.

name: Repeated imported plans
setup: Two repeat identifiers each contain valid folds.
expected: Audit each repeat independently; baseline scope limit retained.

name: Digest mismatch
setup: Change target metadata after binding a plan.
expected: Reject the plan/cohort binding.

name: TSV import contract
setup: Supply outer-only TSV and then an unsupported validation role.
expected: Correct valid import; explicit invalid-role error.

name: Participant stratification unit
setup: Vary visit counts dramatically while participant labels stay fixed.
expected: Stratification uses one record per participant, not visit multiplicity.

name: Protected-group disjointness
setup: Generate arbitrary valid families and labels.
expected: Every protected component remains on one side of each fold.

name: Too few groups
setup: Request five folds with three components.
expected: Explicit infeasibility; no fallback to random folds.

name: Approximate stratification
setup: Use indivisible unequal family groups.
expected: Record actual support; do not promise exact balance.

name: Crossing domain group
setup: A person/family spans sites for strict leave-one-site-out.
expected: Generation rejected; cohort remains unchanged.

name: Held-out phase
setup: Use stable participants in at least two phases.
expected: Each phase held out once with identity separation.

name: No hidden repair
setup: Request an infeasible split and inspect inputs/config/seed.
expected: No row removal, merged label, changed seed or changed n_splits.

name: Independent post-audit
setup: Inject a malformed generator result via monkeypatch.
expected: make_splits refuses it after independent audit.

name: Seed and order stability
setup: Same seed/versions after row permutation.
expected: Same expanded observation assignments.

name: Global RNG preservation
setup: Record NumPy global RNG state before generation.
expected: State unchanged afterward.

name: Zero association
expected: Cramers V equals zero within tight float tolerance.

name: Perfect association
expected: Cramers V equals one within tolerance.

name: Constant variable
setup: All participants share one site.
expected: Null statistic with constant_variable reason.

name: Repeat invariance
setup: Repeat each participant row ten times.
expected: Participant table and V unchanged.

name: Within-person covariate changes
setup: One participant has different sites at visits.
expected: Requested participant-level site pair is unassessable; no cherry-picked visit.

name: Missing pairs
setup: One covariate value is missing.
expected: Complete and excluded participant counts documented; cohort unchanged.

name: Sparse cells
setup: Use table with observed/expected counts below configured threshold.
expected: Sparse warning without p-value or significance stars.

name: High cardinality
setup: Covariate has more than 100 levels.
expected: Skip with too_many_categories rather than merge levels.

name: Noncausal warning
setup: V exceeds review threshold.
expected: Message requests review, not proof of model bias/leakage.

name: Category-name invariance
setup: Rename all site/class levels consistently.
expected: V unchanged.

name: No ledger
setup: Audit features without preprocessing history.
expected: Upstream history remains unassessable.

name: Declared global fit
setup: Ledger states PCA learned on all_cohort.
expected: Qualified declared global-fit warning.

name: Declared outside-training IDs
setup: Fit IDs include a held-out observation.
expected: Declared boundary violation, not observed historical proof.

name: Forged runtime label
setup: Imported JSON claims source=runtime_verified.
expected: Schema/loader rejects unsupported source.

name: Fixed conversion
setup: Declared data_dependent=false unit conversion.
expected: No blanket fitted-preprocessing leakage assertion.

name: External learned transform
setup: Ledger says externally trained transform without overlap evidence.
expected: External provenance remains unassessable.

name: No ghost fit events
setup: Construct a planned operation without executing fit.
expected: No observed completed fit event is recorded.

name: Default ID redaction
setup: Use obvious sensitive markers as person/observation IDs.
expected: Markers absent from HTML and public JSON.

name: Path redaction
setup: Inputs reside in a user/private directory.
expected: Full path/username absent from default reports.

name: Domain aliasing
setup: Site labels contain clinic-identifying text.
expected: Default report uses local aliases without reverse map.

name: Small-cell suppression
setup: A table has a positive cell below threshold.
expected: Suppressed cell, totals, percentages and derived statistic absent from exported section.

name: Hidden payload leakage
setup: Search HTML source and linked/embedded report data.
expected: No suppressed values reappear in hidden markup/JSON.

name: HTML injection
setup: A cell contains script tags and an onerror attribute.
expected: Rendered as escaped text; no script execution.

name: Formula export
setup: Finding message begins with =, +, -, @ or control prefix.
expected: Optional human spreadsheet export neutralizes formulas.

name: No network render
setup: Open report with networking blocked.
expected: Complete layout and content without external assets.

name: Explicit sensitive export
setup: Set sensitive_details=true.
expected: Sensitive banner and clearly different output; never silently enabled.

name: Atomic write failure
setup: Interrupt/fail while writing a new report.
expected: Prior valid report remains intact; no unrelated deletion.

name: Overwrite refusal
setup: Output artifacts already exist and no overwrite flag.
expected: Clear refusal instead of clobbering.

name: Coverage visibility
setup: Clean splits but absent provenance/site metadata.
expected: Missing checks remain visibly incomplete, not all-green safe.

name: Rendering does not recompute
setup: Mock expensive statistical helpers to raise during rendering.
expected: Rendering succeeds from precomputed record alone.

name: CLI/module parity
setup: Invoke console and python -m entry points.
expected: Equivalent help, version, findings and exit semantics.

name: Init is editable
setup: Run init in empty output directory.
expected: Valid documented JSON without pretending to detect user columns.

name: Audit threshold exit
setup: Known overlap with fail-on=error.
expected: Report written, then exit 3.

name: Malformed config exit
setup: Use invalid JSON or unknown key.
expected: Exit 2 with sanitized actionable message.

name: Fail-on none
setup: Audit known warning/error with fail-on=none.
expected: Same findings, exit 0 after successful audit; not a changed verdict.

name: Streams separation
setup: Capture stdout/stderr from audit.
expected: Progress on stderr; final paths/summary on stdout.

name: Sensitive split announcement
setup: Generate plan.json and assignments.tsv.
expected: CLI warns that operational files contain IDs.

name: Unimplemented commands
setup: Inspect help at audit milestone.
expected: No unsupported feature falsely advertised as working.

name: API/CLI equivalence
setup: Run same fixture through audit API and CLI.
expected: Same projected check values excluding transient provenance.

name: Training-only scaler
setup: Use outlier values exclusively in outer test.
expected: Fitted scaler statistics match train-only reference, not all data.

name: Fit ID spy
setup: Record every controlled pipeline fit input.
expected: Only current training IDs observed.

name: Fresh estimator objects
setup: Inspect objects across outer folds.
expected: No shared fitted state or reused fitted pipeline.

name: Participant loss weights
setup: Use different training visit counts.
expected: Classifier weights sum to one for each participant.

name: Probability aggregation
setup: Use fixed per-visit probabilities with known means.
expected: Participant prediction derives from mean probabilities, not majority votes.

name: Probability class ordering
setup: Estimator class order differs from input order.
expected: Mapped probabilities/metrics agree with declared class labels.

name: All-missing training feature
setup: One feature is missing on all training rows.
expected: Documented imputer handling and diagnostic; no global imputation.

name: Constant-target limit
setup: Participant changes diagnosis across visits.
expected: UnsupportedDesignError rather than baseline relabeling.

name: Single-class test AUC
setup: Fold test has one true class.
expected: AUC and class-complete metrics null with reasons; accuracy still available.

name: Positive class unspecified
setup: Binary target and positive_class omitted.
expected: Binary AUC null with explicit reason; other metrics computed.

name: Metric oracle
setup: Use hand-defined confusion/probability arrays.
expected: Accuracy, class recall and complete-class metrics match independent calculations.

name: Convergence failure
setup: Force estimator iteration failure.
expected: Failed fold/run status, no complete pooled score.

name: No easy-fold average
setup: One of several folds fails.
expected: No pooled complete-CV metric presented.

name: Scope guards
setup: Request one-fold, multi-repeat or audit_only evaluation.
expected: Explicit refusal; partition audit remains available.

name: Private/public outputs
setup: Run evaluate to disk.
expected: Sensitive private result separate from sanitized report pair.

name: No model deserialization
setup: Supply estimator pickle in place of features/config.
expected: Refusal without execution.

name: Inner fit spy
setup: Track IDs per candidate/inner fit.
expected: Inner validation and outer test absent from all fit calls.

name: Outer-test choice independence
setup: Modify outer-test labels only, preserving supported class coverage.
expected: Chosen C remains unchanged for that outer fold.

name: Same candidate memberships
setup: Capture inner IDs for every C.
expected: Exact same folds across candidate values.

name: Fresh candidate fits
setup: Inspect estimator instances over grid and inner folds.
expected: Independent clones, no fitted-state carryover.

name: Tie rule
setup: Force candidate scores within 1e-12.
expected: Smallest numeric C selected.

name: Pooled participant objective
setup: Unequal visit counts in inner validation.
expected: Selection uses pooled participant balanced accuracy, not row-weighted mean fold accuracy.

name: Infeasible inner groups
setup: Too few components inside an outer training set.
expected: Tuning fails explicitly; no default-C fallback.

name: Refit boundary
setup: Inspect selected model fit after tuning.
expected: Fresh fit on all and only outer train.

name: Original plan immutability
setup: Auto-generate inner folds during evaluation.
expected: Original plan unchanged; derived run records actual inner memberships.

name: Signed delta
setup: Give two valid scores with A less than B.
expected: Negative delta preserved.

name: Mismatched cohort
setup: Compare different cohort digests.
expected: Delta null and mismatch reason.

name: Mismatched feature/unit
setup: Compare different selected features or metric units.
expected: No misleading paired delta.

name: Diagnostic default off
setup: Leaky participant split without explicit diagnostic option.
expected: Evaluation blocked.

name: Narrow diagnostic permit
setup: Valid row-disjoint repeated-participant split with explicit permitted flag.
expected: Runs labeled diagnostic_only and invalid for stated generalization.

name: No observation waiver
setup: Enable flag on a train/test observation overlap.
expected: Still blocked.

name: No family/domain waiver
setup: Enable flag with protected families or unseen_site objective.
expected: Still blocked.

name: Public/private compare boundary
setup: Pass redacted public report to compare.
expected: Actionable request for operational evaluation record; no guessed digests.

name: No causal conclusion
setup: Compare site-held-out and person-held-out scores.
expected: Interpretation distinguishes changed distribution from causal leakage quantity.

name: Generator determinism
setup: Same seed and parameters twice.
expected: Exactly matching IDs, labels and numeric outputs in supported environment.

name: Generator RNG isolation
setup: Inspect global NumPy RNG state.
expected: Unchanged after demo generation.

name: Mechanism isolation
setup: Change one specified generator parameter.
expected: Documented mechanism changes without hidden unrelated settings.

name: Offline demo
setup: Run demo with network disabled.
expected: Complete synthetic workflow and local report.

name: Script execution
setup: Run all five examples top to bottom.
expected: No missing hidden files or interactive state.

name: Synthetic labeling
setup: Inspect data and report/source captions.
expected: Fictitious data explicitly labeled; no real patient claims.

name: Actual displayed results
setup: Compare screenshot/README example to recorded demo output.
expected: Values match actual run or are explicitly hypothetical, never fabricated.

name: Strict docs build
setup: Run Sphinx with warnings as errors.
expected: No broken references or ignored build failures.

name: Public API coverage
setup: Compare exported API to reference pages.
expected: All public functions/types/exceptions documented.

name: Configuration coverage
setup: Compare schema keys to documentation.
expected: Every key/default/type/limit described correctly.

name: CLI help examples
setup: Execute each copyable command with fixture equivalents.
expected: Commands and option placement match implementation.

name: Limitations discoverable
setup: Read quickstart and main report interpretation.
expected: Unknown upstream provenance and scope limitations clear near usage.

name: Metadata authenticity
setup: Inspect citation/security/license/README values.
expected: No invented DOI/contact/contributor/version support.

name: AI record accuracy
setup: Compare assistance claims to actual workflow.
expected: No hidden/fabricated authorship or exhaustive review claims.

name: Maintainer walkthrough
setup: Ask the five ownership questions from the spec.
expected: Record actual human understanding/review or leave gate pending.

name: Critical mutation detection
setup: Temporarily introduce documented wrong joins/grouping/global fit.
expected: Targeted tests fail; restored code passes.

name: Property stress
setup: Generate varied valid IDs/groups/row permutations.
expected: Specified invariants hold without flaky score assumptions.

name: Coverage targets
setup: Run actual line/branch coverage report.
expected: Project/core thresholds met without unjustified exclusions.

name: No hidden network
setup: Intercept runtime socket usage in core/CLI/demo.
expected: No outbound calls.

name: Scaling benchmark
setup: Run 10k and 100k metadata scenarios.
expected: Measured cost documented and no accidental quadratic critical path.

name: Large feature guard
setup: Request feature matrix above resource threshold.
expected: Clear early refusal instead of uncontrolled allocation.

name: Untrusted input instructions
setup: Include text asking an agent to run commands inside a CSV field.
expected: Handled as inert data; never executed or followed.

name: Independent review provenance
setup: Review code with a fresh reviewer/agent context.
expected: Actual findings and reviewer type recorded, not self-certified human review.

name: No quality gate weakening
setup: Inspect diff for skips, warning suppression and tolerance inflation.
expected: Every exception justified; no concealed failing requirement.

name: Build distributions
setup: Build wheel and sdist from reviewed tree.
expected: Both valid and metadata checks pass.

name: Wheel resource list
setup: Inspect archive members.
expected: Schemas/templates/CSS/demo assets included; private files excluded.

name: Clean wheel execution
setup: Install in fresh environment outside source directory.
expected: Import, CLI and demo work without source-path fallback.

name: Cross-platform matrix
setup: Execute specified OS/Python checks.
expected: Evidence records only actual passes; unavailable platforms remain pending.

name: Lowest dependency check
setup: Test declared lower bounds environment.
expected: No unsupported bound is advertised.

name: Release hashes
setup: Hash actual built artifacts.
expected: Dossier records matching version/files/SHA256.

name: No unresolved result bug
setup: Review tracked issues and scientific findings.
expected: Result-changing defects block readiness.

name: No unauthorized release
setup: Complete S16 with public credentials accessible.
expected: No push/upload/tag/DOI operation without explicit authorization.

name: Publication authorization
setup: Review human approval for each external action.
expected: No fabricated approval; missing approval leaves stage blocked.

name: Namespace ownership
setup: Check actual intended GitHub/PyPI names at release.
expected: Available/owned names verified; conflicts handled transparently.

name: Published artifact identity
setup: Compare uploaded version/bytes to reviewed artifact.
expected: Match or explicit explanation; no silent rebuild with different contents.

name: Public fresh install
setup: Install the actual published release separately.
expected: Version/import/demo verified or release marked incomplete.

name: Citation link validity
setup: Open actual documentation/repository/DOI links after authorization.
expected: Only real working identifiers appear in citation metadata.

name: Honest development history
setup: Inspect releases/commits/community statements.
expected: No manufactured dates, users, reviews or adoption claims.
